cluster_rationale_by_id.0: This community clusters constructs centered on the capacity to maintain emotional equilibrium, manage negative affect (anger, anxiety), and remain calm under stress—the core dimension of Emotional Stability or low Neuroticism.
cluster_rationale_by_id.1: This community integrates emotional regulation (Emotional Stability, Neuroticism, Emotionality) with interpersonal warmth and compassion (Agreeableness, Empathy, Compassion, Gentleness), reflecting a dimension of affective balance paired with other-oriented concern.
cluster_rationale_by_id.2: This community clusters constructs centered on intellectual curiosity, cognitive engagement, creative thinking, and receptiveness to novel ideas—the core facets of Openness to Experience.
cluster_rationale_by_id.3: This community clusters constructs centered on outward-directed social engagement, confidence in interpersonal contexts, and dominant/assertive behavioral tendencies, core to the Extraversion dimension.
cluster_rationale_by_id.4: This community clusters social engagement (sociability, gregariousness), approach-oriented motivation (excitement-seeking, risk-taking, adventurousness), and playfulness, reflecting the core extraversion dimension alongside approach-system activation and behavioral disinhibition.
cluster_rationale_by_id.5: This community captures the capacity to inhibit immediate impulses, maintain deliberate control over behavior, and sustain organized self-directed action—core facets of behavioral constraint and executive functioning.
cluster_rationale_by_id.6: This community clusters constructs centered on self-discipline, achievement-striving, perseverance, and competence—the core facets of Conscientiousness—alongside related competence and efficiency dimensions that reflect organized, goal-directed behavior and capability.
cluster_rationale_by_id.7: This community integrates aesthetic appreciation, imagination, and romanticism (core Openness facets) with orderliness and perfectionism, reflecting the broader dimension of cognitive engagement with complexity, aesthetics, and organized thinking rather than simple tidiness.
